config firewall address
edit "Prefix-Web"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
set comment "Main site"
next

edit "Prefix-DB"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "db.example.com"
set comment "Database 'primary'"
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-Web" "Prefix-DB"
next

end
